name: Deposit-only bank data calculates without optional field errors
description:
Objective: Deposit-only bank data calculates without optional field errors.
Preconditions: Open Calculator with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Calculator.
2. Deposit-only bank data calculates without optional field errors.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The invalid or unauthorized action is rejected and no unintended state change is made.
